sourcePolicy: Original prompt and generated art only; no third-party image pixels sampled; no user ZIP assets used.
prompt: Original Black woman shown in seven stages from crawling infant through elder, with a crescent hair clip, teal scarf identity cue, curls evolving to braids and silver braids, seven distinct age-appropriate outfits, front-facing isolated lineup, pixel-art game character design reference.
editPrompt: Preserve the seven age-stage designs and layout; remove the checkerboard and request genuine transparency, crisp hard-edged pixel clusters, no gradients, antialiasing, or painterly texture.
rights: Provider-generated original concept. Confirm current provider terms before commercial redistribution or product release.

movementConcept.prompt: Use the elder woman at far right of the seven-stage reference: deep-brown skin, silver braids, gold crescent clip, teal scarf, cream patterned shawl, modest walking cane. Keep scale and ground pivot consistent, crisp chunky 16-bit pixel clusters, transparent background, no text or grid lines.
